summary: The reported MLX startup control-flow defect was reproduced at get_resolved_model_impl: Hunyuan's failed architecture resolution propagated even though MLX executes through mlx_lm. The candidate fix returns the non-Transformers implementation classification before architecture or auto_map resolution when the validated MLX backend is active. Model-free regression and non-MLX boundary tests pass. Full Hunyuan serving and decode correctness remain unverified because this Linux AMD host has no Apple Metal/MLX runtime or model weights.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before control flow on the recorded base: get_resolved_model_impl called architecture resolution and propagated ValueError: Cannot find model module. 'HunYuanForCausalLM'.
Three tests passed: MLX bypasses the Hunyuan failure boundary, non-MLX still resolves architecture, and non-MLX cached implementations remain unchanged.
Two existing Transformers fallback tests passed.
All applicable formatting, lint, registry, and repository policy hooks passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect is specific to Apple Silicon MLX/Metal. The assigned gfx950 AMD GPU cannot execute or qualify that backend, so no GPU result is claimed.

remaining_limitations: No Apple Silicon, MPS, MLX, or mlx_lm runtime was available, so the original launch_server command was not run end to end.
mlx-community/Hunyuan-7B-Instruct-4bit weights were not downloaded; model loading, generation, and semantic/decode correctness were not tested.

Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37721 identifies an additional Hunyuan batched-decode correctness issue and proposes broader attention delegation. This narrow candidate addresses only the reported auto_map startup crash and does not claim to solve that separate decode behavior.
